_comment: Where the build looks for the ontology release, in this order. The first file found is used; if none is found, the release is downloaded from ontologyUrl. References come from the HAO project in TaxonWorks (public project token, like TaxonPages). Releases: the GitHub releases of hao2; baseline is the release before the first one (only used for comparison).
title: Hymenoptera Anatomy Ontology

baseline.name: HAO 2.0.0
baseline.notes: First HAO2 release, made with the Ontology Development Kit and placed under the Insect Skeleto-Muscular Ontology (AISM).
